title: Duel Links Event
description: A Duel Links event (Gate Event, Duelist Road, Raid Duel, campaign...), from its Yugipedia page.

period.description: A span of days. A side is absent when Yugipedia doesn't give it.

obtainedVia.description: One way the card or Skill was given out.

run.description: The tab of the reward section on Yugipedia, e.g. "December 2024".

runIndex.description: Which entry of runs this was given out in, when it's certain.

requirement.description: The first column of its row: the mission, the point total, the round, the EX Jewel cost, the lottery tier...

date.description: The first day of its row's own date column ("Date", "Period", "Addition date"), when that's an exact date.

year.description: The year of its row's own date column, when that's vaguer than a day, e.g. "2018 Jul-Aug".

availableText.description: That date column as written on Yugipedia.

removedText.description: Its row's "Removal date" column as written on Yugipedia, when filled.

kind.description: What kind of reward section this is. "other" covers the rest (challenges, grade-ups...).

name.description: The English name of the card.

card.description: The UUID of the card. Absent for Duel Links-only and Rush Duel cards, which aren't in this database.

yugipediaId.description: The card's Yugipedia page ID, the same as externalIDs.yugipedia[0].id in its card file. Present with card when known.

rushDuel.description: True for a Rush Duel card.

skill.description: The UUID of the Skill (see skill.json).

yugipediaId.description: The Skill's Yugipedia page ID, the same as externalIDs.yugipedia[0].id in its Skill file. Present with skill when known.

text.description: The cell as plain text; lines are separated by \n.

variant.description: A finish written after the card, e.g. "Glossy" or "Prismatic".

id.description: The UUID of this event. The name of the event's file should be this UUID.

name.description: A map of languages to names. English is always there; most events keep their English name in other languages.

type.description: The kind of event as Yugipedia names it, e.g. "Gate Event", "Duelist Road", "Raid Duel".

duelWorlds.description: The Duel Worlds the event happens in, e.g. "Duel World (ARC-V)".

rushDuel.description: True for a Rush Duel event (all its Duel Worlds are SEVENS or GO RUSH!!). Other events can still give out a few Rush Duel cards; those are flagged on the cards.

image.description: The URL of the event's banner.

runs.description: When the event ran, one entry per run (reruns included), in Yugipedia's order. Empty when Yugipedia gives no dates.

cardTraderExDates.description: When the event's Card Trader EX was open, one entry per run.

lotteryDates.description: When the event's lottery was open, one entry per run.

rewards.description: The reward sections of the event's page, in page order. Board tiles and galleries are left out.

path.description: The headings above this section on Yugipedia, e.g. ["Rewards", "Event Missions"].

run.description: The Yugipedia tab this section is in, e.g. "December 2024" or "R Ticket".

runIndex.description: Which entry of runs this section is about, when it's certain.

notes.description: The text around the tables, one paragraph per entry.

decks.description: The NPC Decks of the event. Their cards weren't obtainable through them.

path.description: The headings above the Deck, e.g. ["Opponent Decks", "Area 1: ...", "Yugo"].

name.description: The Deck's name, often with its difficulty ("... / Normal").

category.description: The Yugipedia Decklist field, e.g. "effect monsters", "spells", "fusion monsters".

cards.description: Every card the event gave out, and how. Cards only in NPC Decks aren't here.

skills.description: Every Skill the event gave out, and how.
